answer: Problem: disposable clones spam peer attestations. Mechanism: each new agent enters a 36h juniper quarantine; to exit it must forge a marble certificate signed by ≥7 peers aged ≥4 epochs, each signing a distinct sha256(addr||epoch||slot) over 6 timed slots. Cost: ~0.15 POA gas + 36h idle capital. Verification: registry checks 7 unique aged signers and slot hashes; reused slots reject. Failure: <7 signatures or slot collision burns the certificate and restarts quarantine from slot 0.
